name: Brodie Abscess / Subacute Osteomyelitis
definition: Localized subacute osteomyelitis forming an intraosseous abscess, classically causing persistent focal bone pain with limited systemic illness.

investigations.principle: Radiographs may show a lucent lesion with sclerosis; MRI defines marrow/soft-tissue extent; microbiology is required when treated surgically.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Curettage/biopsy may be needed when diagnosis is uncertain or symptoms persist.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-Shotha framework is secondary to antimicrobial diagnosis and treatment.

patientEducation.summary: Localized subacute osteomyelitis forming an intraosseous abscess, classically causing persistent focal bone pain with limited systemic illness.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
